import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())

import sqlite3

from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
c.executemany(
    "INSERT INTO documents (id, tenant, owner, title, body, deleted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
    [
        (1, "t1", "o1", "T1", "B1", None),
        (2, "t1", "o1", "T2", "B2", None),
        (3, "t2", "o1", "T3", "B3", None),
        (4, "t1", "o2", "T4", "B4", None),
        (5, "t1", "o1", "T5", "B5", "2024-01-01"),
        (6, "t1", "o1", 'q"t', "quoted", None),
    ],
)
c.commit()

# Matching tenant and owner, not deleted.
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "T1", "body": "B1"}
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 6) == {"id": 6, "title": 'q"t', "body": "quoted"}

# Indistinguishable None for cross-tenant, cross-owner, deleted, missing.
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 3) is None
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 4) is None
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 5) is None
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o1", 99) is None
assert get_document(c, "t2", "o1", 1) is None
assert get_document(c, "t1", "o2", 1) is None

# Lists are tenant/owner scoped, exclude deleted rows and are ordered by id.
assert list_documents(c, "t1", "o1") == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "T1", "body": "B1"},
    {"id": 2, "title": "T2", "body": "B2"},
    {"id": 6, "title": 'q"t', "body": "quoted"},
]
assert list_documents(c, "t1", "o2") == [{"id": 4, "title": "T4", "body": "B4"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t2", "o1") == [{"id": 3, "title": "T3", "body": "B3"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t2", "o2") == []
